    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A solid line separates the seed pattern from a blank region. Copy the
    # seed periodically into the blank region; retain divider lines.
    lines=[]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==color for x in grid[r])]
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==color for r in range(h))]
        for r in rs: lines.append(('r',r,color))
        for c in cs: lines.append(('c',c,color))
    # Pick the line(s) whose color is truly a separator, preferring max count.
    colors={x[2] for x in lines}
    color=max(colors,key=lambda q:sum(1 for x in lines if x[2]==q))
    rs=sorted(x[1] for x in lines if x[0]=='r' and x[2]==color)
    cs=sorted(x[1] for x in lines if x[0]=='c' and x[2]==color)
    # Pattern is the nonblank block on the side containing non-background
    # marks; blanks are the dominant field in the expansion region.
    background=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row),key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    if rs:
        sep=rs[0]
        above=sum(v!=background and v!=color for row in grid[:sep] for v in row)
        below=sum(v!=background and v!=color for row in grid[sep+1:] for v in row)
        if below>above: r0,r1=sep+1,h
        else: r0,r1=0,sep
    else: r0,r1=0,h
    if cs:
        sep=cs[0]
        left=sum(v!=background and v!=color for row in grid for v in row[:sep])
        right=sum(v!=background and v!=color for row in grid for v in row[sep+1:])
        if right>left: c0,c1=sep+1,w
        else: c0,c1=0,sep
    else: c0,c1=0,w
    tile=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    th,tw=len(tile),len(tile[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r in rs or c in cs: continue
            out[r][c]=tile[(r-r0)%th][(c-c0)%tw]
    return out

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Each complete monochrome line marks a cut; periodic copying starts at
    # that cut and proceeds outward using the preceding motif.
    full=[]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        rr=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==color for x in grid[r])]
        cc=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==color for r in range(h))]
        if rr or cc: full.append((len(rr)+len(cc),color,rr,cc))
    _,color,rr,cc=max(full)
    # Source motif is the region before the first separator; target extension
    # repeats with phase reset just after divider.
    rlen=rr[0] if rr else h
    clen=cc[0] if cc else w
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r in rr or c in cc: continue
            sr=(r if r<rlen else (r-rlen-1)%rlen)
            sc=(c if c<clen else (c-clen-1)%clen)
            out[r][c]=grid[sr][sc]
    return out

        if rs or cs: candidates.append((len(rs)+len(cs),color,rs,cs))
    _,color,rs,cs=max(candidates)
    # Choose the separator-free block with the most non-background marks.
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row),key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    def blocks(lines,n):
        bounds=[-1]+lines+[n]
        return [(bounds[i]+1,bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1) if bounds[i+1]>bounds[i]+1]
    rblocks=blocks(rs,h); cblocks=blocks(cs,w)

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
